origin: Primary hypothesis after reading the two optimizer originals; not a proposal or endorsement returned by the API consultant.
name: Fixed quantum label states for relation-conditioned token attention

evidence_boundary.observed_source_fact: The current head uses40 independent learned rank1 effects in complex dimension8. Forty effects cannot all be pairwise orthogonal.
evidence_boundary.unverified_bottleneck: Whether the learned effect geometry actually creates harmful crosstalk between confusable relations is unknown. No query-collapse, semantic-bottleneck or expected-gain observation is claimed.
evidence_boundary.accepted_old_evidence: Original scopedL4 utility/local alignment remains on the unchanged old model. It does not transfer to this design. R51 dataset qualification/common-protocol evidence is reused only as task-entry context.

proposed_operation: Replace40 free query states with40 fixed rank1 label-state projectors chosen from5 mutually unbiased orthonormal bases in complex dimension8, if exact construction and useful state-preparation reachability can be verified. Keep the relation-wise Born token weights and complete40 signed value/readout. The40effects remain independent binary tests; this is not a learned joint40outcome POVM.
assignment_question: A prospective train-only procedure might assign confusable labels to the same basis, giving orthogonal within-basis queries and equal between-basis overlap. Any confusion graph must be derived without test or already-exposed validation fitting, with its own frozen selection rule. No graph/assignment/data have been computed.
changed_assumptions: Fixed query projectors replace learned circuit-effect parameters; this changes the old model and needs its own controls and independent evidence.
Five complex8-dimensional MUBs and the required preparation circuits are not yet constructed or original-source verified here. Native depth2pi*tanh ansatz reachability is NOT assumed.
No restriction is added to the free complete40 value/readout to force the theory to pass. A theory may state explicit utility-alignment/noise conditions and must fail if those conditions are absent.
theorem_target: For a specified distribution of token quantum states with near-label signal state, approximately isotropic background and bounded deviations of signed utilities from a common signal-evidence pattern, derive a complete40 logit-margin/CE bound in terms of query coherence, background anisotropy, state error and utility error. Then check whether train-only label-to-basis assignment reduces a genuinely task-weighted risk bound. Known frame/MUB identities and an illustrative ideal-noise calculation are tools, not the contribution by themselves.
ideal_sanity_case_not_a_result: If one signal token has projector equal to its label query, eight background tokens sum toI, and all relation utilities are1on signal/0on background with no classbias, then signal alpha for overlapq is(q+eps)/(q+1+9eps). Correctq1 versus wrongq<=1/8 gives a positive complete40 margin. This is a conditional engineered example, not a native-ansatz realization, advantage over freely coadapted classical controls, or evidence from Re-TACRED.
nearest_collisions_to_read: Multiclass quantum classifiers with fixed target/fidelity label states, including data re-uploading.
MUB/SIC frames and quantum state discrimination/line packing; a geometric identity alone is known.
Error-correcting output codes and data-dependent class-code assignment.
Existing label-wise and quantum attention methods; straightforward codebook substitution may already be covered.
falsifiers: If nearest originals already implement the same operation/prediction, close promotion rather than rename it.
If the conditional margin remains only an elementary known codebook example without a distinct task-dependent statement, it does not establish L5.
If actual training-only evidence does not support harmful query crosstalk or useful utility/noise conditions, do not use the story to justify formal training.
If the preparation family cannot realize the required states under a declared budget, revise or stop before experiments; do not silently enlarge it.

A new model would need matched dimension/parameter/optimization controls, including appropriately larger real or lifted classical alternatives; no quantum-exclusive or global-family superiority claim.
next_action: Read closest original fixed-label-state quantum-classification work and MUB construction/packing sources before derivation or implementation. Deduplicate existing R1/R49 sources. No new formal experiment, checkpoint recovery or annotation.
